automationNotes: Doc §App Releases: default **Basic Information** loads on app open; **Releases** lives in **left navigation** (qualifying **public** apps). Table columns **Release**, **Title**, **Type**, **App Version**, **Status**, **Created By**, **Created At**, **Actions**; then row **⋯** → **View** → release details **modal**. **Private** apps often omit **Releases** — flow may fail earlier. Empty release list fails row actions.
